_metadata.author: claude-session (included allowance, no API)
_metadata.purpose: First authored sample for reviewer inspection: twelve pairs from the 50-word shortlist, with the hints the author kept and the hints the author rejected, and why. Nothing here is human-approved. Status 'candidate' until the blind review (reviews/) has run.
_metadata.rules: One-word hints only. A hint never equals either target. About three strong hints per pair is a soft goal, never a quota or cap: a pair with one strong hint is kept, never padded. Superficial variants are recorded under variants. There is no board-word or other-word competition rule (owner decision 2026-10-17); a hint that also fits other bank words is judged on the pair alone.
_metadata.author_labels: The author labels (clues / variants / rejected) are the author opinion only. Every hint, including the rejected ones, went to the blind reviewer unlabeled; the merged library takes its status from the blind verdict, not from these labels.
_metadata.laterText: Player-facing text written AFTER the blind review for hints the author had not kept but the reviewer passed (no new review was needed for the text). The verdict came first; the text only lets the hint be shown. 2026-10-17 later in the day: CREEPY, JERRY and MUFASA added on the owner's direction.
